title: DomainBoundaryManifest
description: Schema for a target repo's docs/tooling/domain-boundary-manifest.json, per docs/tooling/domain-boundary-provenance-hook.md §4. Declares the pipeline config/spec files this hook inspects (pipelineConfigGlobs) and the identifiers that count as domain-boundary reads requiring a DOMAIN-BOUNDARY: citation (externalSourceIdentifiers).

pipelineConfigGlobs.description: Glob patterns (relative to repo root, POSIX-style, matched with Python's stdlib fnmatch.fnmatch()). '*' matches any characters INCLUDING path separators; '**' has no special recursive meaning and behaves identically to '*'. Identifies files this pipeline treats as its own config/spec surface — the files this hook inspects on Edit/Write. A file not matching any entry is never inspected (silent pass).

externalSourceIdentifiers.description: Explicit list of identifiers that, if found in an inspected file's proposed content, count as a domain-boundary read requiring citation. Each entry is a literal substring or a 're:'-prefixed Python regex (case-sensitive). No wildcard/glob semantics here.
